title: Compassionate Use of an Intravenous Fish Oil Emulsion in the Treatment of Liver Injury in Infants

sections.abstract:
To provide a mechanism for critically ill infants with parenteral nutrition (PN) associated cholestasis to receive Omegaven for compassionate use situations for which there are no satisfactory alternative treatments.

Posted outcomes: Time to Resolution of Parenteral Nutrition Associated Cholestasis Prior to End of Study. timeframe=From initiation to end of study (End of Study : Discontinuation of Fish Oil Emul. Fish Oil Emulsion Arm=38.02 (±23.9)
